 "cells": [

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "09607234",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prepare Data for Cell2Net Training on PBMC\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial demonstrates the comprehensive data preparation pipeline for Cell2Net training using Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMC) multiome data. We'll transform raw single-cell measurements into analysis-ready datasets optimized for regulatory network modeling.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Overview\n",
    "\n",
    "Cell2Net requires carefully prepared multiome data that integrates:\n",
    "1. **Gene expression profiles** (RNA-seq) \n",
    "2. **Chromatin accessibility** (ATAC-seq)\n",
    "3. **DNA sequence information** for regulatory regions\n",
    "4. **Transcription factor motif annotations**\n",
    "5. **Peak-to-gene regulatory relationships**"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "fd35204a-9f3e-4229-9e2c-4640e69e3e78",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<mudata._core.config.set_options at 0x7fe8ebb76f60>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 2,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [

    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
    "\n",
    "import os\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import scanpy as sc\n",
    "import mudata as md\n",
    "import cell2net as cn\n",
    "\n",
    "md.set_options(pull_on_update=False)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "## Load Raw PBMC Multiome Data\n",
    "\n",
    "Import the preprocessed PBMC multiome dataset containing paired RNA-seq and ATAC-seq measurements. This dataset represents the full cellular diversity of the peripheral blood immune system."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "1af0da21-aed2-4f3a-9cde-c74d95d3f1db",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "mdata = md.read_h5mu(f'./mdata.h5mu')"

  },

   "source": [
    "## RNA Data Preprocessing\n",
    "\n",
    "Apply standard single-cell RNA-seq normalization and dimensionality reduction:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Total count normalization**: Scale gene expression to account for sequencing depth differences\n",
    "2. **Log transformation**: Stabilize variance and make data more normally distributed  \n",
    "3. **Principal Component Analysis**: Reduce dimensionality while preserving major expression patterns\n",
    "\n",
    "This preprocessing is essential for identifying highly variable genes and computing cellular similarities."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "63fe6390-0bdf-44ab-ab01-c813cc652e84",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "sc.pp.normalize_total(mdata['rna'])\n",
    "sc.pp.log1p(mdata['rna'])\n",
    "sc.tl.pca(mdata['rna'], n_comps=30, use_highly_variable=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "c3691be7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Visualize Cellular Diversity\n",
    "\n",
    "Explore the immune cell populations and their marker gene expression patterns. This visualization helps us understand:\n",
    "- **Cell type distribution**: Major immune populations (T cells, B cells, monocytes, etc.)\n",
    "- **Marker gene expression**: TCF4 (B cell/pDC marker) and IRF8 (myeloid/DC marker)\n",
    "- **Data quality**: Well-separated cell types indicate good data quality"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "db798f26-e7ad-4a46-887d-d4b807bfda81",
   "metadata": {},

     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "sc.pl.umap(mdata[\"rna\"], color=[\"cell_type_v2\", \"TCF4\", \"IRF8\"])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "962c2f8a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create Metacells for Network Modeling\n",
    "\n",
    "Generate metacells to aggregate similar single cells for improved Cell2Net training:\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Why Metacells?**\n",
    "- **Noise reduction**: Average out technical variability while preserving biological signal\n",
    "- **Computational efficiency**: Reduce dataset size from ~10K cells to 1K metacells\n",
    "- **Statistical power**: Improve signal-to-noise ratio for regulatory relationships\n",
    "- **Cell type preservation**: Maintain representation of all immune populations\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Metacell Generation Process**:\n",
    "1. **Similarity calculation**: Use PCA and nearest neighbor graphs\n",
    "2. **Community detection**: Group similar cells using clustering algorithms  \n",
    "3. **Expression aggregation**: Average gene expression within each metacell\n",
    "4. **Quality control**: Ensure metacells represent coherent cell states"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "f3737f1a-1822-4a3a-b842-34173a78129b",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "2025-11-28 17:53:06 INFO     Total number of metacells to create: 1000\n",
      "2025-11-28 17:53:07 INFO     Select 1000 metacells using geosketch\n",
      "2025-11-28 17:53:07 INFO     Select 1000 metacells using geosketch\n",
      "2025-11-28 17:53:08 INFO     No groupby provided, using all cells\n",
      "2025-11-28 17:53:08 INFO     Create KNN graph with X_pca and 15 neighbors\n",
      "2025-11-28 17:53:08 INFO     No groupby provided, using all cells\n",
      "2025-11-28 17:53:08 INFO     Create KNN graph with X_pca and 15 neighbors\n",
      "2025-11-28 17:57:32 INFO     Done\n",
      "2025-11-28 17:57:32 INFO     Done\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "mdata_bulk = cn.tl.get_metacells(mdata, n_metacells=1000)"
   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5197c246",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Process and Visualize Metacells\n",
    "\n",
    "Apply dimensionality reduction to metacells for quality assessment and visualization:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Re-normalize**: Account for aggregation effects in metacells\n",
    "2. **PCA**: Capture main expression variation patterns  \n",
    "3. **Neighborhood graph**: Build cell similarity network\n",
    "4. **UMAP embedding**: Create 2D visualization of metacell relationships\n",
    "\n",
    "This processing ensures metacells maintain the biological structure of the original data while providing noise reduction benefits."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "55ffbd1b-1c35-44a1-87da-c7e6bb8f430f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# visualize metacells\n",
    "sc.pp.normalize_total(mdata_bulk['rna'])\n",
    "sc.tl.pca(mdata_bulk['rna'], n_comps=30, use_highly_variable=True)\n",
    "sc.pp.neighbors(mdata_bulk['rna'])\n",
    "sc.tl.umap(mdata_bulk['rna'])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fab8fc00",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Validate Metacell Quality\n",
    "\n",
    "Visualize metacells colored by cell type and marker genes to ensure:\n",
    "- **Cell type preservation**: Each metacell maintains coherent cell identity\n",
    "- **Marker gene expression**: Key lineage markers (TCF4, IRF8, IRF1) show expected patterns\n",
    "- **Spatial organization**: Similar cell types cluster together in UMAP space\n",
    "- **Reduced noise**: Smoother expression patterns compared to single cells"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "bf69db27-cc5e-4e5f-a2d1-ee4bce122dac",
   "metadata": {},

      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "sc.pl.umap(mdata_bulk['rna'], color=[\"cell_type_v2\", \"TCF4\", \"IRF8\", \"IRF1\"])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "54e926e7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Add Genomic Annotations\n",
    "\n",
    "Integrate essential genomic information for Cell2Net modeling:\n",
    "\n",
    "### **1. Gene TSS Coordinates**\n",
    "- Extract transcription start site (TSS) positions from GTF annotation\n",
    "- Define promoter regions for regulatory analysis\n",
    "- Enable distance-based peak-to-gene associations\n",
    "\n",
    "### **2. Peak Sequence Extraction** \n",
    "- Define 256bp windows around ATAC-seq peaks\n",
    "- Extract DNA sequences from reference genome\n",
    "- Prepare sequence data for attention mechanisms\n",
    "\n",
    "### **3. DNA Sequence Integration**\n",
    "- Link each accessibility peak with its DNA sequence\n",
    "- Enable sequence-guided regulatory modeling\n",
    "- Support motif-based feature extraction\n",
    "\n",
    "This genomic annotation is crucial for Cell2Net's sequence-aware architecture."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "4e1541d3",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {

     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [

      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "cn.pp.add_gene_tss_coord(mdata_bulk, gene_gtf='../../../../data/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A/genes/genes.gtf.gz')\n",
    "cn.pp.add_peaks(mdata_bulk, mod_name='atac', peak_len=256)\n",
    "cn.pp.add_dna_sequence(mdata_bulk, ref_fasta='../../../../data/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A/fasta/genome.fa')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b9d5b0d5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Load and Filter Transcription Factor Motifs\n",
    "\n",
    "Prepare transcription factor binding site motifs for regulatory analysis:\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Motif Database (JASPAR2024)**:\n",
    "- Comprehensive collection of experimentally validated TF binding motifs  \n",
    "- Position weight matrices (PWMs) for sequence scanning\n",
    "- Covers major transcription factor families relevant to immune cells\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Gene-Based Filtering**:\n",
    "- Retain only motifs for TFs expressed in our PBMC dataset\n",
    "- Reduces computational complexity and focuses on relevant regulators\n",
    "- Ensures TF-target relationships are biologically plausible\n",
    "\n",
    "This curated motif set enables identification of functional TF binding sites in accessible chromatin regions."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "a6749694",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",

     "text": [

      "2025-11-28 17:57:47 INFO     Number of motifs overlapped with genes: 390\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "motifs = cn.pp.get_tf_motifs(database='JASPAR2024')\n",
    "cn.pp.filter_motifs_by_genes(motifs, mdata_bulk)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2b2e30e3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Scan for Transcription Factor Binding Sites\n",
    "\n",
    "Identify TF binding sites within accessible chromatin regions:\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Motif Matching Process**:\n",
    "1. **Sequence scanning**: Apply TF motifs to DNA sequences of ATAC-seq peaks\n",
    "2. **Score calculation**: Compute binding affinity scores based on position weight matrices\n",
    "3. **Threshold filtering**: Retain high-confidence binding site predictions\n",
    "4. **Genomic annotation**: Map binding sites to peaks and nearby genes\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Output**: \n",
    "- Binary matrix indicating TF binding site presence/absence in each peak\n",
    "- Quantitative scores for binding site strength\n",
    "- Spatial relationships between TFs, peaks, and target genes\n",
    "\n",
    "This motif matching provides mechanistic links between TF activity and chromatin accessibility for Cell2Net modeling."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "c8ce0ed9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {

      "\n",

     ]

   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5f178d15",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Establish Peak-to-Gene Regulatory Links\n",
    "\n",
    "Create the core regulatory network by linking accessible chromatin regions to target genes:\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Peak-to-Gene Mapping Strategy**:\n",
    "1. **Distance-based associations**: Link peaks to nearby genes within reasonable genomic windows\n",
    "2. **Correlation analysis**: Compute associations between peak accessibility and gene expression across metacells\n",
    "3. **Sequence-guided refinement**: Use DNA sequence features to improve link predictions\n",
    "4. **Statistical significance**: Apply multiple testing correction for robust associations\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Key Parameters**:\n",
    "- **min_n_peaks=3**: Require minimum peak count per gene for reliable modeling\n",
    "- **highly_variable=True**: Focus on genes with informative expression variation\n",
    "- **inplace=True**: Store results directly in the MuData object\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Output**: \n",
    "Peak-to-gene association matrix forming the foundation for Cell2Net's attention-based regulatory modeling."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "0503d175",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {

    "                   inplace=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "227a111b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Construct TF-to-Gene Regulatory Networks\n",
    "\n",
    "Build transcription factor regulatory networks by integrating motif information with peak-to-gene links:\n",
    "\n",
    "### **TF-Gene Network Construction**:\n",
    "1. **Motif-peak associations**: Identify which TFs have binding sites in each peak\n",
    "2. **Peak-gene links**: Use previously computed peak-to-gene associations  \n",
    "3. **Transitive relationships**: Connect TFs to genes via their binding peaks\n",
    "4. **Network aggregation**: Combine multiple TF-peak-gene paths into regulatory scores\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Regulatory Logic**:\n",
    "```\n",
    "TF → Binding Site (in Peak) → Accessible Chromatin → Target Gene Expression\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Output**:\n",
    "- TF-to-gene regulatory network matrix\n",
    "- Regulatory scores reflecting potential influence strength  \n",
    "- Mechanistic basis for understanding gene expression control\n",
    "\n",
    "This network provides Cell2Net with biologically-informed priors about transcriptional regulation in immune cells."
   ]
  },
  {

   "execution_count": 17,
   "id": "f34effcb",

      "Finding TFs: 100%|██████████| 1927/1927 [00:42<00:00, 45.29it/s]\n"
     ]
    }

   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3a43497f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Prepare Metadata and Covariates\n",
    "\n",
    "Consolidate essential metadata for Cell2Net training:\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Key Metadata Integration**:\n",
    "1. **Cell type annotations**: Preserve immune cell population identities\n",
    "2. **Count statistics**: Total RNA and ATAC counts per metacell for quality control\n",
    "3. **Cross-modal integration**: Ensure consistent cell identifiers across RNA and ATAC modalities\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Quality Control Metrics**:\n",
    "- **total_counts_rna**: Total gene expression per metacell (sequencing depth)\n",
    "- **total_counts_atac**: Total accessibility counts per metacell (data quality)\n",
    "- **cell_type information**: Biological context for model interpretation\n",
    "\n",
    "This consolidated metadata enables Cell2Net to account for technical factors while modeling biological regulatory relationships."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "id": "c6211da6",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df_obs_rna = mdata_bulk['rna'].obs[['cell_type', 'cell_type_v2', 'total_counts']]\n",
    "df_obs_rna = df_obs_rna.rename(columns={'total_counts': 'total_counts_rna'})\n",
    "\n",
    "df_obs_atac = mdata_bulk['atac'].obs[['total_counts']]\n",
    "df_obs_atac = df_obs_atac.rename(columns={'total_counts': 'total_counts_atac'})\n",
    "\n",
    "df_obs = pd.concat([df_obs_rna, df_obs_atac], axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "mdata_bulk.obs = df_obs.copy()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "acc8a596",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Add Log-Transformed Covariates\n",
    "\n",
    "Create log-transformed versions of count statistics for model training:\n",
    "\n",
    "### **Model Covariates**:\n",
    "- **total_counts_rna_log**: Accounts for RNA sequencing depth variation\n",
    "- **total_counts_atac_log**: Accounts for ATAC-seq technical differences\n",
    "\n",
    "These covariates allow Cell2Net to separate technical effects from true biological regulatory relationships."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 19,
   "id": "dbaca065",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "mdata_bulk.obs['total_counts_rna_log'] = np.log10(mdata_bulk.obs['total_counts_rna'])\n",
    "mdata_bulk.obs['total_counts_atac_log'] = np.log10(mdata_bulk.obs['total_counts_atac'])"
   ]
  },
